promise: "Tesla will be feature complete for Full Self-Driving by the end of this year."
description: Tweeted in August 2019, part of a long series of FSD deadline promises (2019, 2020, 2021, 2024...). Full Self-Driving remained an incomplete beta in 2024-2025, requiring driver supervision and lacking regulatory certification — it was nowhere near feature-complete or autonomous by end of 2019.
evidence: FSD remained a supervised beta system through 2025
Musk's own later statements pushed deadlines to 2020 and beyond
No driverless/robotaxi FSD deployment existed by end of 2019

review.note: Search locates February podcast and October call, not the alleged August 16 tweet. 'Feature complete' was distinguished from unsupervised/regulator-approved driving; failure cannot be established solely by continued supervision.

promise: Pobreza cero - we are going to end poverty
description: Macri campaigned in 2015 on the slogan 'pobreza cero' (zero poverty), promising to end poverty during his presidency. Poverty instead rose from roughly 29% when he took office to around 35% by the end of his term in December 2019, with some projections above 40% at his worst point, making the pledge a symbol of broken campaign promises in Argentina.
evidence: Poverty rate rose to ~35.5% at end-2019, up from ~29% in 2015
INDEC poverty figures peaked above 40% during his term (2020 readings for 2019-2020)
sources: La Nación / BBC Mundo (2019 end-of-term assessments)

review.note: INDEC table shows 35.5% and later 40.9%; 2020 is after Macri's presidency and cannot count as a within-term peak. Need original slogan/date/deadline and comparable baseline; 2015 and resumed official 2016 series cannot be assumed identical.

promise: We will plant 4 billion trees this rainy season
description: Abiy launched Green Legacy on May 26, 2019 with a four-billion-seedling target. Ethiopia's agriculture ministry reports 4.7 billion planted in 2019; this is a government-reported count, not independent confirmation of survival.
evidence: Ministry's retrospective reports 4.7 billion seedlings planted against a four-billion target.
sources: Ethiopian Ministry of Environment (2019 Green Legacy reports)

review.note: Participant organization dates launch May 26, not May 10. Ministry self-reports 4.7 billion for 2019. Claimed planting is distinct from independently verified planting/survival or a certified world record; rainy-season deadline is not necessarily December 31.

promise: Tesla Semi truck to enter production and start deliveries in 2019
description: Tesla first delivered Semi trucks to PepsiCo on December 1, 2022, after an initial 2019 production target.
evidence: Reuters reports the initial 2019 target and first deliveries in December 2022.

review.note: Reuters supports 2019 production target and first December 1, 2022 deliveries: delayed fulfillment. June 30 predates November unveiling. Local evening reveal/delivery timestamps require UTC checking before exact date replacement.

promise: Expect the 737 MAX return to service to begin in the fourth quarter of 2019
description: Boeing's October 23, 2019 results forecast the 737 MAX would begin returning to service in Q4 2019, subject to regulatory approval. The FAA authorized return-to-service steps on November 18, 2020; GOL resumed commercial flights on December 9, 2020.
evidence: GOL's January 8, 2021 investor update confirms its December 9, 2020 commercial flight from Guarulhos to Porto Alegre. Service resumed after the Q4 2019 forecast window; this was a conditional corporate forecast, not an unconditional safety guarantee.

promise: Apply Israeli sovereignty to the Jordan Valley and northern Dead Sea upon forming a new government, conditional on an electoral mandate
description: Netanyahu made the conditional pledge September10,2019 ahead of the election. He also linked annexation steps to coordination with the Trump administration.
evidence: Annexation pledge made September 10, 2019, ahead of the September 17 election
Israeli sovereignty was never applied over the Jordan Valley

review.note: Pledge depended on a mandate and forming a government, with US coordination. No December31 deadline established; later formation/annexation outcome requires matched evidence. Do not convert conditional post-election timing into an arbitrary annual date.
